name: sgs/form
title: SGS Form
description: Form wrapper with multi-step support, validation, and N8N webhook notifications.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: WS-4 composite-mirror — outer wrapper emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper('layout', render.php:366-382), inheriting sgs/container's full LAYOUT-scope capabilities. color/typography/border are block-private, scoped via render.php:131-198 (mirrors sgs/container's render.php pattern).

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Composite-mirror grid capability (shared SGS_Container_Wrapper, kind='layout'). Maps explicitly — no `prefix` declared, so the default convention cannot resolve bare camelCase attrs (ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1).

submit-button.label: Submit button
submit-button._note: submitColour/submitBackground resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention (Colour/Background suffixes). Rendered as a scoped rule on `.uid .sgs-form__button--submit` (render.php:211-228, contract §A) — not inline. submitBackgroundGradient's attrMap entry added 2026-09-03 (the default convention has no Gradient-suffix awareness, so the gradient sibling floated as an unclaimed orphan).

prev-button.label: Previous-step button
prev-button._note: The multi-step form's Previous button (.sgs-form__button--prev), distinct from submit-button. Added 2026-09-03 alongside the hover-colour + gradient migration off a hardcoded style.css :hover rule -- render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'prev', which reads exactly this attrMap shape by $prefix.'Suffix' concatenation.

progress-bar.label: Progress bar
progress-bar._note: progressBarColour drives the `--sgs-progress-colour` custom-property value; progressBarColourGradient drives the `--sgs-progress-colour-gradient` sibling (2026-09-04). Both are custom-property-fed (not real declarations), so mapped explicitly. The gradient wins when set (render.php line 290 uses sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls).

focus-ring.label: Focus ring
focus-ring._note: formFocusRingColour/Width/Opacity/Offset (render.php:82-86,237-243) drive :focus-visible custom-property values on form inputs — a distinct focus-ring control surface outside the Text/Fill/Layout/Position/Motion clusters (no 'outline colour'/'ring width' member exists), so this element declares no CLUSTER members and its attributes surface as ORPHANs (FR-35-4), same treatment as sgs/button's icon element. It DOES declare an explicit attrMap (2026-08-02): these four drive custom-property VALUES rather than being real declarations, so each is mapped to the property it semantically controls — the same treatment progressBarColour gets above, and for the same reason. Opacity is mapped to `css:opacity`, NOT to `css:box-shadow`: style.css:211-217 composes TWO --sgs-* vars (colour + opacity) into ONE box-shadow via color-mix, so no single attr owns that property, and declaring this one as the box-shadow would assert something untrue. Without the attrMap the emission tracer resolved formFocusRingOpacity to box-shadow with css_element NULL, which the F6 reseed-survival check correctly flagged as an undeclared sub-element paint that would misroute on a clone.

successMessage.default: Thank you! Your submission has been received.

submitColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the submit button's text (background-clip:text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over submitColour at render time (D636/778879732 gradient rollout finish, 2026-09-04). Not mapped in submit-button's attrMap: css:background-image is already claimed by submitBackgroundGradient on this same element (JSON keys are unique) — render.php resolves the runtime collision via the D942 background-color:transparent cancellation, but if an operator sets BOTH this AND submitBackground/submitBackgroundGradient simultaneously, the background paint wins (documented trade-off, see render.php comment).

progressBarColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the progress bar with a gradient instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over progressBarColour at render time.

layout.description: Composite-mirror review (P2-2, container's layout-default fix): sgs/form routes through SGS_Container_Wrapper::render() the same way sgs/container does, so an untouched form would otherwise inherit container's new 'flex'/row default and lay its fields out side-by-side. Form fields are unambiguously vertical, so this block declares its own explicit 'stack' default rather than sharing the primitive's.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

attributes.successMessage: Thank you! We'll be in touch shortly.
